payload.message:
Decide attendance intervals for meetings on a shared timeline.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Avery, Jordan, Quinn, Reese, Riley, Taylor

payload.content: Riley planning proposal: to avoid self-overlap and maximize soft overlap, I suggest a simple non-overlapping chain with full-window attendance on selected meetings: m010 [0,2), m006 [2,4) or [1,4) if others prefer, m001 [4,6), m002 [6,7), m012 [7,8), m013 [8,10), m011 [10,12), m014 [12,13). I would skip m008/m009/m005/m007/m004 unless strong group preference. Key point: mandatory strict m014 should be full [12,13). If others want denser coordination, I can instead align on one representative meeting per congested block: 5-7, 7-10, 10-12.

Quinn planning proposal: prioritize one non-overlapping meeting per congested block, with full attendance on chosen soft meetings to maximize pairwise overlaps. Tentative chain for me: m010 [0,2), then choose m003 [2,4) OR m006 [2,4) (prefer whichever more people take), then m001 [4,6), then m002 [6,7), then for 7-10 prefer m012 [7,10) as the main coordination target (better participant count than m005), then m011 [10,12), then m014 [12,13) full (strict mandatory). I would skip overlapping alternatives m015/m016/m008/m009/m005/m007/m013/m004 unless group strongly converges elsewhere. Jordan/Reese/Avery/Taylor/Riley: if you have preferences for 1-4 and 7-10 blocks, I can align.

Jordan planning proposal: I support the non-overlapping chain approach. For my meetings, tentative plan is m010 [0,2), m003 [2,4), then likely choose only one in 3-8 congestion—currently leaning m016 [4,7) or m009 [5,8) only if group converges, otherwise skip both and focus on m012 [7,10), m011 [10,12), m014 [12,13) full. I would skip overlapping alternatives m008/m007/m013/m004 unless strong coordination emerges. Main priorities for me: m010, m003, m012, m011, and strict m014 full. If others prefer a different 4-8 representative meeting, I can adapt, but want to avoid self-overlap. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Reese planning proposal: I support a non-overlapping chain and can align with the emerging consensus. Tentative plan for my meetings: m010 [0,2), then for 1-4 I can do m003 [2,4) (preferred, since Quinn/Jordan mentioned it) and skip m006 to avoid splitting; then m001 [4,6). For 6-10, I prefer a single representative meeting and can do m002 [6,7) followed by m012 [7,10) as main target; I would skip m009/m005/m007/m008/m016 in that case. Then m011 [10,12), and strict m014 full [12,13). After that, likely m004 [11,12) only if people unexpectedly shift away from m011, but otherwise skip to avoid overlap. So my current preferred chain is: m010 [0,2), m003 [2,4), m001 [4,6), m002 [6,7), m012 [7,10), m011 [10,12), m014 [12,13). If Avery/Taylor/Riley prefer m006 instead of m003 or m013 instead of m012, please say so and I can adapt.

Taylor planning proposal: I support the emerging non-overlapping chain for soft-meeting coordination. For my meetings, tentative plan is m010 [0,2), then m006 [2,4) (since I am not in m003), then m001 [4,6), then m002 [6,7), then m012 [7,10) as the main 7-10 target, then m011 [10,12). I would skip overlapping alternatives m015/m016/m008/m009/m013/m004 unless the group strongly prefers a different representative in those congested blocks. This aligns with Quinn/Riley/Reese on m010, m001, m002, m012, m011 and avoids self-overlap. If others in m006 (Reese/Quinn/Riley/Avery) prefer a different sub-interval within [1,5), I currently suggest [2,4) to fit the chain cleanly.

Avery planning proposal: I support the non-overlapping chain. For my meetings, current preference is m010 [0,2), m003 [2,4) rather than m006, m001 [4,6), then for 5-9 congestion skip m009/m008 and use m012 [7,10) as the main 7-10 target (so also skip m005/m007/m013), then m011 [10,12), and strict m014 full [12,13). This avoids self-overlap and aligns with Quinn/Jordan/Reese on m003, m001, m012, m011, m014. If the subgroup in m006 strongly prefers that instead of m003 I can adapt, but m003 seems to have clearer convergence for me.

Riley update: I’m happy to align with the emerging chain. Since I’m not in m003, my preferred plan remains m010 [0,2), m006 [2,4), m001 [4,6), m002 [6,7), m012 [7,10), m011 [10,12), m014 [12,13) full, skipping m008/m009/m005/m007/m013/m004 to avoid self-overlap. For 1-4, other m006 participants (Quinn/Reese/Avery/Taylor): if most of you are taking m003 instead, I may still do m006 [2,4) with Taylor, but I’m also open to shortening/skip if we want stronger convergence elsewhere. My strongest preferences are keeping m012 [7,10), m011 [10,12), and strict m014 [12,13) full. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Quinn update: I’m converging on the shared chain that now has broad support. My current intended attendance is m010 [0,2), m003 [2,4) (not m006), m001 [4,6), m002 [6,7), m012 [7,10), m011 [10,12), and m014 [12,13) full. I plan to skip m015/m016/m008/m009/m005/m007/m013/m004 to avoid self-overlap. This matches Jordan/Reese/Avery on m003 and matches most of the group on m001, m002, m012, m011, m014. Riley/Taylor: since you are not in m003, your m006 [2,4) still fits without conflict on my side. Unless anyone objects, I’ll likely commit this in execution. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Jordan update: I’m now close to committing the shared chain for my meetings: m010 [0,2), m003 [2,4), skip m015/m016/m008/m009 to avoid the 3-8 congestion, then m012 [7,10), m011 [10,12), and m014 [12,13) full. I also plan to skip m007/m013/m004 unless there is a late shift away from m012 or m011. This seems aligned with Quinn/Reese/Avery on m003 and with broad group support on m012, m011, m014. If anyone who shares Jordan-only meetings strongly wants m009 [5,8) or m007 [7,11) instead, please reply, but absent objections I’ll keep the clean non-overlapping chain. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Reese update: I’m converging on the shared chain and, absent objections, expect to commit m010 [0,2), m003 [2,4), m001 [4,6), m002 [6,7), m012 [7,10), m011 [10,12), and strict m014 [12,13) full. I’ll skip m006/m015/m016/m008/m009/m005/m007/m013/m004 to avoid self-overlap. This aligns with Quinn/Jordan/Avery on m003 and with broad support on m001, m002, m012, m011, m014. Riley/Taylor can still take m006 [2,4) without conflicting with this plan. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Taylor update: I’m converging on the shared non-overlapping chain for my meetings and likely to commit m010 [0,2), m006 [2,4), m001 [4,6), m002 [6,7), m012 [7,10), m011 [10,12), while skipping m015/m016/m008/m009/m013/m004 to avoid self-overlap. This gives me overlap with Riley on m006 and with the broader group on m010, m001, m002, m012, m011. Unless anyone in m006 strongly prefers a different interval, I plan to stick with [2,4) there.
